questions.question: A shape with two round flat ends and one curved side is a ___.
questions.explain: A cylinder has two round flat ends and one curved side. A cone only has one round face, so it is not the answer.

questions.question: A shape with one round flat face and one pointy top is a ___.
questions.explain: A cone has one round flat face and a pointy tip. A cylinder has TWO round faces, so it is a different shape.

questions.question: A box with 6 flat square faces is a ___.
questions.explain: A cube is a 3D box with 6 square faces. A square is a flat 2D shape, not a 3D object.

questions.question: A shape with a flat square bottom and 4 slanted sides that meet at one point is a ___.
questions.explain: A pyramid has slanted sides that meet at one point at the top. A prism has two flat parallel ends and straight sides.

questions.question: A box has 5 shapes: 3 cubes, 1 sphere, and 1 more. The last shape has one round flat face and a pointy top. What is it?
questions.explain: One round flat face and a pointy top describes a cone. A cylinder would have two round faces, not one.

questions.question: Sam picks out shapes that have NO flat faces at all. He finds 4 of them. What shape are they?
questions.explain: Only a sphere is all curved with no flat faces. Cubes, cylinders, and cones each have at least one flat face.

questions.question: Liam says: 'A cone has two flat round faces and a curved side.' What went wrong with his sentence?
options: He mixed up cones and pyramids
He mixed up cone and cylinder
He said the curved side was flat
questions.explain: A cone has ONE round face. Two round faces with a curved side describe a cylinder, so Liam confused the two.

questions.question: Two shapes are in a bag: one has two round flat faces, the other has no flat faces. What are they?
questions.explain: Two round flat faces make a cylinder, and no flat faces at all means a sphere. A cone has only one round face.

questions.question: It is all round and curved. It has no flat sides and no corners. What 3D shape is this?
questions.explain: A sphere is all round with no flat parts. A circle is flat, so it is a 2D shape, not a 3D one.

questions.question: Every side is a square. All six sides are the same size. What 3D shape is this?
questions.explain: A cube has six square sides. A square is flat and 2D, so it cannot be the name of a 3D shape.

questions.question: It has two flat round tops. The side between them is curved. What 3D shape is this?
questions.explain: A cylinder has two flat round tops and a curved side. A cone only has one round bottom and a pointy top.

questions.question: It has one flat round bottom. The top comes to a single point. What 3D shape is this?
questions.explain: A cone has one round bottom and a pointy top. A pyramid also has a pointy top, but its bottom is flat and not round.

questions.question: Dad puts up a backyard tent. It has a flat square bottom and comes to a point at the top. What shape is the tent?
questions.explain: A pyramid has a flat bottom and a pointy top. A prism is a box shape with no pointy top.

questions.question: A box of crayons has 6 flat sides. The sides are not all the same — some are longer than others. What 3D shape is the box?
questions.explain: A prism (or rectangular prism) has flat sides of different lengths. A cube must have all six sides as equal squares.

questions.question: Ava says her shape has a flat bottom and a pointy top. It does NOT have a round bottom. What shape is it?
questions.explain: A pyramid has a flat bottom and a pointy top. A cone also has a pointy top, but its bottom is round, which Ava said it is not.

questions.question: A toy top has a flat round bottom and a pointy top. A juice can has two flat round tops. Which one is a cone?
questions.explain: A cone has one round bottom and a pointy top, like the toy top. A juice can has two round tops, so it is a cylinder.

questions.question: Riya says: 'A pyramid has two flat round tops and a curved side.' What is wrong with her sentence?
options: It has a pointy top, not a round one.
It is all round and curved, like a ball.
It is a flat shape, like a triangle.
It has six square sides, like a cube.
questions.explain: A pyramid has a flat bottom and a pointy top. Two round tops and a curved side describe a cylinder, not a pyramid.

questions.question: Ana plays a drum at the school assembly. The top and the bottom of the drum are flat circles. The side curves all the way around. What 3D shape is the drum?
questions.explain: Two flat circle ends with a curved side means cylinder. A cone has only one round end, and it ends in a point.

questions.question: Zoe sees a big glass shape at the museum. The bottom is a flat square. Four flat triangles lean in and meet at one point on top. What 3D shape is it?
questions.explain: Flat faces that lean in and meet at one point make a pyramid. A prism has two matching ends and no single point.

questions.question: Omar opens a long box of granola bars. Each end of the box is a flat triangle. The long faces are flat rectangles. What 3D shape is the box?
questions.explain: Two matching triangle ends joined by flat rectangles make a prism. A pyramid would rise to one point, not have two ends the same.
